description: Convert an HTML string to clean Markdown (GFM tables, fenced code, nested lists). No fetch. Body: { "html": "...", "base_url"?: "https://...", "extract_main"?: false }. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/html-to-markdown

base_url.description: Optional http(s) URL used only to absolutise links (never fetched)

extract_main.description: Strip boilerplate, keep main content (default false)

html.description: HTML to convert (JSON body; the service caps request bodies at 256 KB)

name: html_to_markdown
title: Html To Markdown
